q.g: In this quest you first have to find a golden Zibbo lighter on Customs. It can be found on a desk in room 303 on the third floor of the three-story dorms building. A Dorm room 303 key is required to enter it, you also will need to stash a regular Zibbo lighter in Doom room 303

sh.c: 3 story dorms, room 303 and cabin marked on map
